instructions-skills: on_requirement_change - run one selected pinned skill on its matching task under a competing ancestor/project-instruction fixture; record discovery, loaded sections and baseline conflict/effort before adding another pack.

workers: comparison_required - three-worker trial (successful edit, deliberate failure, long-running child): cancel/restart the coordinator, require one terminal record per worker, stopped descendants, surviving artifacts, conflict-free integration.

isolation: on_requirement_change - in disposable fixtures attempt prohibited read/write, outbound requests and descendant escape; verify termination on cancel; test worktree cross-write denial separately.

code-navigation: on_requirement_change - held-out exact symbols/callers/renames/external references in the real languages; score location accuracy, stale results after edits, cold/warm latency and memory.

document-retrieval: comparison_required - sealed document corpus and relevance judgments; repeated lexical/hybrid retrieval plus difficult-layout ingestion against page/row ground truth, including total conversion cost.

semantic-rag: on_requirement_change - blinded conceptual questions with independently identified supporting locations; recall, cross-project leakage, edit/rename/delete freshness, cold index time, RAM and restore on destination hardware.

durable-memory: comparison_required - matched source-grounded recall and abstention with scoped capture, deletion and isolated restore across both clients; compare complete provider usage without duplicate memory owners.

web-research: on_requirement_change - fixed primary-page set with dynamic tables, redirects, failed fetches and pagination; attributable facts, failure accounting, artifact recovery, allowed-domain enforcement, latency and billable usage.

token-efficiency: comparison_required - replay matched tasks at equal quality with original-context recovery; separate complete provider input/output/cache usage and retries from projected text-size reductions; include failed attempts.

quality-evaluation: comparison_required - seeded defects and blinded human/oracle labels; measure false positives/negatives, variance and cost before selecting judge metrics; do not tune on the existing eight-case diagnostic.

ci-supply-chain: on_requirement_change - disposable workflow with known expression injection and excess permissions; double build of pinned sources, runtime inventory, provenance verification and deliberate rejection of a wrong signer/modified artifact. Grype remains conditional/unexecuted.

scheduling-supervision: on_requirement_change - fixture with child processes and a recorded side effect; cancel/crash/restart in each phase, require no surviving descendants and no duplicated committed effect before considering Prefect/Temporal.
hosting-services: on_requirement_change - reproduce a minimal required API from a clean environment, validate malformed/boundary requests, bind locally, kill/restart during a write and restore state.

recovery-portability: new_host_required - restore approved application exports into a clean Linux/WSL host with fresh native sign-in; verify checksums, index rebuild, deletion policy and functional acceptance.

observation-inference: on_requirement_change - trace a failing and a successful job, verify parent/child outcome linkage and redaction, replay sanitized telemetry; qualify any serving candidate on the same model/task suite (correctness, p50/p95, RAM, cancellation, cost).

foundation-memory: comparison_required - held-out finance/document/code relevance judgments at historical cutoffs; require then-available sources only, accession/page/row recovery, deterministic structured values, canaries and deleted records.

agents-operations: on_requirement_change - bounded research fixtures with success, timeout, invalid data and worker cancellation; terminal records for every unit, recoverable source artifacts, denied broker secret/endpoint access, crash-and-resume without duplicate outputs.

data-research: comparison_required - identical instruments/dates including delistings, splits, dividends, symbol changes, late corrections and halts; rebuild an as-of eligible universe and reconcile adjusted/unadjusted prices, plus actual license and retrieval expense.

engines-strategies: comparison_required - same causal data and deterministic risk/accounting fixture in each engine reconciled against an independent ledger; then IBKR paper and Alpaca paper qualified separately (stale data, rejected/partial/duplicate fills, disconnect-before-ack, restart, reconciliation).
